Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Aarav - 10 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Neeta - 37 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The bathroom - a tap, a bucket, a mirror

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Neeta stands near him.]

Neeta: "What lovely weather!"

[Aarav dances to the music.]

Aarav: "I knew it!"

[Aarav sings a song.]

Aarav (softly): "Okay."

[Aarav hugs Mother tightly.]

Neeta: "Okay, Aarav."

[Aarav points at the sky.]

Neeta (happily): "What next?"

[Aarav nods.]

Neeta: "What next?"

[Aarav gives Mother a flower.]

Aarav: "That was fun!"

Scene 2: The bathroom - Day

[Aarav stands in the bathroom. Neeta stands near him.]

Neeta: "What a nice place."

[Aarav brushes his teeth at the sink.]

Aarav: "Let's see."

[Aarav takes a quick bath.]

Aarav: "I really enjoyed today."
